Description: Something has been storing food here. Cocooned shapes hang from the ceiling in rows, and a wet, heavy breathing echoes from deeper in the larder. Whatever lives here is not home right now.

Replies.SsText: You cut down a few cocoons and slip away with their contents before anything notices.
Replies.FlText: A wet roar answers the sound of tearing silk. The owner has come home.

Replies.ReplyText: Leave a gift of supplies for the owner.
Replies.SsText: The breathing stops, then slowly resumes. A mound of glowing spores is left in your path, and your cards feel sharper for it.
You back out without disturbing the cocoons.
